description: This file defines the SEO Regex controller class for the admin interface of an OpenCart-based project. It handles rendering views, processing user input for listing, adding, editing, and deleting SEO regex rules, as well as coordinating with models and views.

classes.name: SeoRegex
classes.description: Controller class for managing SEO regex rules in the admin area, facilitating CRUD operations and view rendering.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to render the SEO regex list view with breadcrumbs and page setup.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to retrieve the list of SEO regex rules.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates HTML for the SEO regex list, including pagination and links to edit each rule.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a SEO regex rule.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submission to create or update a SEO regex rule.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected SEO regex rules.
